_readme: Every move has a shelf life. status: new (trying it) | current (proven, default pick) | watch (getting overused or trendy; needs a reason in the plan) | retired (never use). Manage with scripts/moves.py.

moves.name: Density over cuts
moves.why: Something new every ~2s on one held color field. Energy without chaos.
moves.next: Try with flavor color fields from the real label.

moves.name: Print-on-page flicker
moves.why: Stills swap fast inside a still frame. Shows lots of real photos without looking like a slideshow.
moves.next: Real gym/customer photos (with permission) flickering inside a label-shaped frame.

moves.name: Breathe then burst
moves.why: 4-6s talking head, then quick inserts on every word. Holds attention without constant cutting.
moves.next: Burst on the line that names the flavor.

moves.name: Strike-through list
moves.why: Says what we're NOT (no fake claims, no 3D tubs). Builds trust fast.
moves.next: EN/ES list: 'No miracles. No fake fire. Just flavor and a hard workout.'

moves.name: Highlighter reveal
moves.why: One flat accent block on one phrase. Emphasis without glow.
moves.next: Highlight color = sampled label color.

moves.name: Mono note card
moves.why: Small monospace cards read like real documentation.
moves.next: Supplement Facts callout in Space Mono: '200 mg caffeine · 2 g L-carnitine · every dose on the label'.

moves.name: Still number with its source
moves.why: Replaces count-ups. The number is finished and sourced.
moves.next: Price card: $29.99, sourced.

moves.name: Film the screen / film the label
moves.why: Phone camera on a real object reads as real. Moire and texture prove it.
moves.next: Handheld macro across the real label.

moves.name: Label macro push-in
moves.why: Slow real push-in on the real tub/label. The product is the evidence.
moves.next: Rack focus from label to athlete behind it.

moves.name: Scoop + pour with real foley
moves.why: The ritual. Real sound of scoop, lid, and shaker replaces stock whooshes.
moves.next: Overhead, in time with the beat.

moves.name: Hard cut on the beat
moves.why: Loud gym energy comes from the edit, not effects.
moves.next: Cut on the plate drop / bar slam in the footage, not only on music.

moves.name: Bilingual line swap
moves.why: Same beat, EN line then ES line in the same position. The brand's soul without subtitles everywhere.
moves.next: Let the Spanish line be the punchline, not a translation.

moves.name: Flavor color field
moves.why: Full-frame flat flavor color (sampled from label) as a cut/title card.
moves.next: Hard cut through the four flame colors: Mango #E7950D → Watermelon #DA6024 → Kiwi Strawberry → Cucumber Lime #BFD02C (brand/brand.md).

moves.name: Type on the wall
moves.why: In the scene, not on top: type tracked onto a gym wall/floor/mirror.
moves.next: 'SÍ, QUEMA' tracked onto the rubber floor under the bar.

moves.name: Sweat / chalk macro
moves.why: Real heat instead of fire particles.
moves.next: Chalk cloud in backlight for the 'quema' beat.

moves.name: Mid-set face, held
moves.why: The burn of the set is the 'quema'. Hold on the face 1-2s longer than feels comfortable.
moves.next: Pair with silence, then the beat drops.

moves.name: Hairline pointer
moves.why: A thin line from a word to the real thing on the label. Points at something real.
moves.next: Point at the flavor name on the tub.

moves.name: Price stamp
moves.why: Big, flat, still price. Straight talk.
moves.next: End card: flavor + $34.99 (sources: price-<flavor>-one-tub) + store URL. Anton caps.

moves.name: Disclaimer end card
moves.why: The FDA disclaimer as a designed, readable card, not microtext. Required with any benefit claim.
moves.next: EN/ES stacked, 2s minimum.

moves.name: Silence before the drop
moves.why: Half a second of room tone before the beat hits. Louder than any riser.
moves.next: Before the flavor reveal.

moves.name: Handheld follow into the gym
moves.why: Real camera move instead of whip pans in post.
moves.next: Follow the shaker from the car to the rack.

moves.name: Text behind head
moves.why: One-tap effect in every editing app now. Overused.
moves.next: Only if the words sit in the room's depth and light (match grade, occlusion, shadow).

moves.name: Word-by-word pop captions
moves.why: Everyone uses them. Fine for retention, zero brand.
moves.next: If used: no bounce, brand font, no emoji, settle not pop.

moves.name: Speed ramp
moves.why: Works on real lifts, but gets old fast.
moves.next: One per video max, on a real rep.

moves.name: Count-up number
moves.why: Scam tell. Replaced by still-number-with-source.

moves.name: Glowing body / product
moves.why: AI slop. Replaced by real light in the shot.

moves.name: Orbit rings
moves.why: AI slop.

moves.name: Fire particles for 'quema'
moves.why: Cheap literal read of the name. Replaced by sweat-macro.

moves.name: 3D tub spinning on gradient
moves.why: Fake product. Real label only.

moves.name: Before/after body
moves.why: Compliance + Meta policy + scam tell.
